us1549-mayday-0.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. Cactus fifteen forty-nine. Bird strike. Lost thrust in both engines.

us1549-left-0.text: Maintain glide speed. Turn left and assess landing areas.

us1549-hold-0.text: Hold this heading while we assess.

us1549-return-0.text: Try returning to LaGuardia. Report our margin.

us1549-assess-0.text: Assess the return and compare other areas.

us1549-river-0.text: Prioritize the river option. Turn toward it.

us1549-hold-option-0.text: No commitment yet. Continue the current instruction.

us1549-teb-0.text: Assess Teterboro and turn toward it.

us1549-commit-0.text: We are committing to a water landing. I have control.

us1549-hudson-0.text: Cactus fifteen forty-nine. Preparing to ditch in the Hudson.

us1549-hudson-unable-0.text: Cactus fifteen forty-nine. Unable to return. Preparing to ditch in the Hudson.

us1549-early-0.text: I have control. Continuing as practice.

us1549-evacuate-0.text: Evacuate! Use the available exits. Put on your life vests.

us1549-power-0.text: Emergency power sequence started. Attempting a relight.

us1549-bird-0.text: Both engines are losing thrust. I have control. Maintaining airspeed.

us1549-restart-0.text: Relight attempt complete. No thrust recovered on either engine.

us1549-return-1.text: Turning toward LaGuardia. Monitoring our energy.

us1549-assess-1.text: I will keep flying and assess the turn and alignment margins.

us1549-lga-low-0.text: The return margin is insufficient. Turning and aligning will cost more height.

us1549-lga-margin-0.text: The return margin is small. We still need to turn and align.

us1549-lga-reachable-0.text: There is still an estimated return margin. Watch the airspeed.

us1549-river-1.text: Turning toward the river. Awaiting your final decision.

us1549-hold-option-1.text: Continuing. We are still losing altitude.

us1549-teb-low-0.text: Teterboro has insufficient margin. Consider the water option.

us1549-commit-1.text: You have control. I will monitor airspeed and altitude.

us1549-gear-0.text: The gear is extended. Keep it up for ditching.

us1549-config-0.text: Keep the gear up. Prepare flaps two as energy permits.

us1549-flaps-0.text: Flaps two set. Gear remains up.

us1549-river-established-0.text: Established along the river. Keep watching the water ahead.

us1549-speed-0.text: Airspeed low. Ease the back pressure and preserve energy.

us1549-shore-0.text: We are approaching the riverbank. Correct the track.

us1549-closing-0.text: The aircraft remains afloat. Rescue assistance is under way.

us1549-lga-0.text: Cactus fifteen forty-nine, LaGuardia is available for an emergency return. Say intentions.

us1549-alternatives-0.text: Cactus fifteen forty-nine, Teterboro is another option to assess. Say intentions.

us1549-hudson-1.text: Roger. Alerting rescue services on the river.

us1549-hudson-unable-1.text: Roger. Alerting rescue services on the river.

us1549-rescue-0.text: Rescue boats are approaching. Remain on frequency.
